function.name: pmfby_get_crop_coverage_details

season.description: Crop season. Kharif = June-October (paddy, cotton, maize). Rabi = November-April (wheat, mustard, gram). Zaid = April-June (watermelon, cucumber, fodder crops).

function.name: pmfby_submit_application
function.description: Submits a new crop insurance application for a farmer under PMFBY. This enrolls the farmer for insurance coverage for a specific crop and season. Prerequisites: None, but premium details are typically calculated beforehand. It does NOT submit crop loss claims or check application status.

farmer_name.description: Full name of the farmer applying for insurance

crop_name.description: Name of the crop to insure

season.description: Crop season. Kharif = June-October (paddy, cotton, maize). Rabi = November-April (wheat, mustard, gram). Zaid = April-June (watermelon, cucumber, fodder crops).

function.name: pmfby_submit_claim
function.description: Submits a crop loss or damage claim under PMFBY for an insured crop. Prerequisites: pmfby_submit_application must have been completed and the crop must be insured. It does NOT check claim status or process claim settlement.

application_id.description: Application ID of the insured crop

loss_date.description: Date on which crop loss occurred

season.description: Crop season. Kharif = June-October (paddy, cotton, maize). Rabi = November-April (wheat, mustard, gram). Zaid = April-June (watermelon, cucumber, fodder crops).

ground_truth: pmfby_submit_application(farmer_name='Ravi Kumar', aadhaar_number='112233445566', crop_name='maize', season='Kharif', area_hectare=3.0, application_type='new')
chain_rationale: A farmer cannot submit a claim without an active policy. Coverage details must be checked to confirm the crop and loss cause are notified before an application and subsequent claim are submitted.
